invariants.rationale: EngineProperty key should not be null as it is generally used as a configuration identifier.
String value may be null or non-null; this expresses that both are permitted.
If value is non-null and empty, then value.isEmpty() holds, capturing its empty-state property.
The method receiver should not be null at method entry.
Trivially true, included as a baseline (all Java method entries satisfy this).
